archetype: Precision Intelligence & Kinetic Learning (Swiss High-Contrast + Cyber Elegance)

theme_strategy.description: Dark-first aesthetic with obsidian depth, ambient glass glows, vibrant kinetic violet/indigo accents for AI features, neon emerald for coding success & streak momentum, and high legibility data structures.

typography.font_family_heading: Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground

pairing_rules: Headings MUST NOT use standard Inter. Use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans with tracking-tight.
Code editors, DSA problem inputs, and streak stats MUST use JetBrains Mono or Fira Code.
Overlines/Eyebrow labels MUST be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em], with a subtle primary-accent tint.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 dark:bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800/60 shadow-xl
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: relative rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-500/10 via-transparent to-transparent p-[1px]
visual_enhancers.card_style: rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6 transition-all duration-200 hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/5
visual_enhancers.glowing_badge: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-indigo-500/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20

grids_and_layouts.app_shell: Flex layout with fixed left sidebar (64px collapsed, 256px expanded), sticky top header (height 64px, z-40 with backdrop blur), and scrollable main content region.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6
grids_and_layouts.coding_arena_layout: Split pane with left problem statement & test cases, right Monaco/CodeMirror code editor and console output.

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion_usage: Page transitions with opacity fade and slide-up (y: 12 -> 0). Staggered children animations for course cards, roadmap nodes, and quiz options.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive buttons and cards MUST have visible hover transforms (scale-102 or translate-y-[-2px]) and border color shifts.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Animated streak counter pulse, progress bar fill animations, voice tutor waveform visualizer, code runner pulse state.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion using Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook or tailwind motion-reduce utilities.

component_guidelines.shadcn_customization: All Shadcn components (Dialog, Select, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Accordion, Progress, Toast) MUST be styled with Tailwind classes matching the glassmorphism and indigo dark palette. Do NOT leave standard grey default look.
component_guidelines.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, form fields, tab buttons, modal triggers, card actions) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="ai-tutor-send-btn", data-testid="streak-counter-badge").
component_guidelines.toast_library: Use Sonner (import { toast } from 'sonner') for toast notifications.
component_guidelines.date_pickers: Use Shadcn Calendar / Popover date pickers. NEVER native HTML input type='date'.
component_guidelines.select_menus: Use Shadcn Select or DropdownMenu components. NEVER native HTML select tags.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both Student and Teacher (Instructor) personas can be simulated or switched easily with clear UI role toggles.
Implement comprehensive mock/real OpenRouter AI capabilities for Study Tutor, Roadmap Generator, Quiz Generator, Coding Assistant, and Resume ATS Analyzer.
Maintain an energetic gamification bar at the top or sidebar: Daily Streak counter, XP points, Level badge, and daily goal progress.
Support full dark and light mode toggle with smooth theme transition.
Provide global search (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K modal) for searching courses, topics, DSA questions, and tools.
All cards with content must have padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collisions with borders.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain clean left alignment and structural hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop look. Use layered dark tones, glowing borders, crisp typography, and interactive micro-animations.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) as primary UI icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons instead.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific property transitions like transition-colors, transition-transform, or transition-opacity.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have data-testid attributes.
Ensure max overlay opacity over photos does not exceed bg-black/50 so background imagery remains visible.
Maintain rich empty states, loading skeletons, and clear error boundaries for all dynamic views.
